info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Pargasit Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Pargasit Drill Detail Management API provides the functionality to add detailed information about Pargasit drilling equipment into the catalog. This endpoint is essential for organizations that specialize in drilling operations, enabling them to maintain an up-to-date inventory of their drilling tools and specifications. Typical consumers of this API include equipment manufacturers, drilling contractors, and project managers who require a centralized resource for managing drilling details. By streamlining the cataloging process, the API enhances operational efficiency and supports informed decision-making in drilling projects.

post.summary: Create a new Pargasit drill detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail related to the Pargasit drill. Make sure to provide all required information in the request body to ensure successful creation.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating or updating details for a Pargasit drill operation. This JSON object should contain the necessary properties required to specify the operational details of the drill, following the defined schema.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, returning the requested details.

CreateCatalogPargasitDrillDetailRequest.title: Pargasit Drill Operation Request

pargasit_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the Pargasit drill.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the drill.

tags.description: Tags associated with the drill operation for categorization.

items.description: A single tag associated with the drill operation.
